description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Marketo Leads via the native createOrUpdate action. POST /rest/v1/leads.json with action=createOrUpdate atomically creates or updates each record in one request, matched on lookupField (typically email). Requests are chunked at 300 records (Marketo's hard per-request limit).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Marketo Lead (upserted via lookup_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_skipped / rows_errored / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Marketo.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

lookup_field.label: Lookup Field
lookup_field.description: Marketo field used as the createOrUpdate match key. MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Marketo field API name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). Chunked at 300 per request (Marketo's hard limit) regardless.

name: Marketo Lead Upsert
